traversalNotes: DEAD-END topology: enter and leave via spawn_south; the section exit is the in-room goal pad, not a doorway.

DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective (key drop, enemy kill, story trigger) should route through corridor_mid (hzj4). Walk south_gate → corridor_mid → objective → corridor_mid → goal_pad. This keeps the autopilot from cutting diagonals across the room that drift into the wall in narrow areas.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions here are stage-local mesh-space XZ; cell.rotation in the quest plan is a gate-label swap only.
